scope.summary: Implement and qualify the LiveSync/EveryWear-equivalent real-time engine delivery lane: versioned live authoring previews, promotion auto-sync, auto-rig, LOD generation, texture bake, and explicit UE/standard-export engine adapters with fail-closed capability rows.
acceptance_criteria: The UE export bridge (MT-254) is extended so that when auto_sync=true is set in the export request, any TailorGarmentPromoted event triggers an automatic re-export to the configured UE watched folder without operator action
The auto-sync path uses the existing export job infrastructure (MT-318 scheduler) and emits a TailorGarmentExportCompleted event with sync_target='ue_watched_folder'

Live authoring preview streams immutable versioned garment/body/material snapshots with explicit opt-in, bounded rate/backpressure, reconnect/resume, stale-version rejection, cancellation, attribution, and no authority writes from the engine consumer.

EveryWear-equivalent auto-rig, LOD generation, and texture bake run as cancellable checkpointed jobs with input/output hashes, artifact manifests, quality profiles, inspected results, atomic publication, and recovery; placeholders or deferred notes cannot qualify the required child rows.

UE uses the configured real-time/watched-folder adapters; Unity and other consumers use the qualified standard glTF/GLB or USD lanes unless a versioned native adapter capability row exists. Each adapter/absence is explicit in TailorCapabilityRegistryV1 and unsupported required rows keep full parity unavailable.

Native controls and backend actions expose connect, preview, auto-sync, rig/LOD/bake, progress, cancel, reconnect, cleanup, diagnostics, receipts, and UserManual anchors through one action authority with Argus/AccessKit and no foreground focus steal.

The exact TailorSurfaceDescriptor row MT-446 enumerates every route, pane, control author_id, dynamic entity-key rule, action, state, help anchor, permission, undo policy, receipt, and command binding; wildcard-only evidence is rejected.

Applicable blank, loading, populated, stale/conflict, cancelled, failed, retry, permission, keyboard/focus, narrow/4K/DPI, overlap/clipping, and no-focus-steal states are covered by the registry-derived Argus matrix.
scope.risk_if_missed: Without promotion-triggered sync and the complete EveryWear-equivalent rig/LOD/bake lane, every iteration requires manual export and refit steps, making Tailor impractical for rapid game-engine character-art production and leaving the professional engine-delivery capability unqualified.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

surfaces: Tailor Jobs, Problems, Diagnostics, and History projections

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > Publishing and DCC interchange

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.
Long-running, native, or external-process work must register bounded progress and child/process identity with the shared Palmistry watcher; Tailor must not fork a watcher.

required_changes_before_execution: Added gui_obligation, user_manual_obligation, and HBR-INT-009 tier obligations from the current MT template without removing original scope.
Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.

requirements: Resolve Principal, AuthenticatedSession and AccessSpace before every resource read or mutation.
Use PostgreSQL RLS/FORCE RLS and ResourceBroker-backed artifact/file handles; UI filtering is never the security boundary.
Derived resources preserve the intersection of source access scopes and must not leak existence through counts, search, previews, logs, traces, caches, diagnostics, exports or model context.
